'''2010 Canadian Nationals Alex O'Shea LS Plead My Case To The Senate''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Alex O'Shea]] at [[2010 Canadian Nationals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Plead My Case To The Senate / Sanity And Compassion|Cor-L-pleadmycasetothesenate.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' If I've Senate Once, I've Senate a Thousand Times
* '''Username:''' Thursday
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.1]]
